sourceEntry: 2026-10-28 — Admin mobile navigation and Rx capture (local source)
releaseSummary: Admin dashboard links beside the account-drawer username and on the profile. Shared mobile admin headers move secondary controls into the profile menu; the sidebar opens from an edge tab as a temporary drawer. Rx capture supports repeated camera photos and selecting multiple files, with larger touch controls and refresh for captures from other devices. Not deployed.
